headline: Amazon Cuts Classification Costs by 98%
lede: For a fixed 20-category ticket queue, Amazon swapped a general-purpose model for a compact decision system. Latency fell 78%, token use fell 70%, and estimated cost dropped from $22,200 to $500 per million tickets.

headline: Ransomware Takes Queens Library Offline
lede: A ransomware attack has disabled the library’s website, app, public computers, and digital lending services. Branches remain open, but renewals are paused while the network outage is contained.

headline: Anthropic Ships Fable and Mythos 5.2
lede: Two versions, one underlying model: Fable targets broad access, while Mythos is reserved for vetted cybersecurity and biomedical organizations. Anthropic reports faster generation, lower pricing, stronger coding and reasoning, and new safeguards against misuse.

headline: USPS Maps the Boundaries ZIP Codes Never Had
lede: The Postal Service now publishes official polygons for ZIP Codes, giving analysts a consistent geographic proxy for identifiers designed primarily for mail routing. The dataset improves provenance without erasing the underlying ambiguity of ZIP Code geography.

headline: Fossil CO₂ Emissions Dip, but the Peak Waits
lede: The Global Carbon Project forecasts a 0.4% decline in fossil-fuel emissions in 2026, as clean energy and electric vehicles meet more demand. Total emissions still rise when land-use change is included, leaving the long-term trajectory unresolved.

headline: Broadcast TV Reveals Movement Through Walls
lede: A receiver listening to ordinary television signals can detect the fading caused by a moving person’s reflections. The same physics may apply to Wi-Fi and LTE—an inexpensive sensing technique, and a quiet reminder that wireless privacy has edges.

headline: AI Speed Can Leave Codebases Brittle
lede: Coding agents increase output, but local solutions do not automatically produce durable systems. The argument is familiar and increasingly urgent: without deep human understanding, faster pull requests can compound hidden failures, technical debt, and customer-facing incidents.
pullquote: A faster codebase is not necessarily a stronger one.

headline: Third-Party AI Breach Exposes Notion Transcripts
lede: Fireworks AI suffered a security incident that may have exposed unattributed Notion AI transcripts from fewer than 1% of workspaces. Metadata was removed, but the text itself could still reveal sensitive people, organizations, or credentials.

headline: A Browser Network Locates One Elusive Beep
lede: Phones, tablets, and laptops become synchronized microphones in a small, practical sensing experiment. FFT filtering, a reference chirp, and a Python WebSocket server narrow the source to within 40 centimeters: a dying carbon monoxide detector.

headline: A Capacitor Bank Puts a Gigawatt in a Speaker
lede: The experiment stores energy in a high-voltage capacitor bank, then releases it through a pneumatic switch in microseconds. The speakers do not survive, but the demonstration cleanly separates instantaneous power from total energy—and makes the hazard unmistakable.
